en.headline: Hongkong Post to offer two-year contracts instead of permanent terms
en.dek: About 200 postal officers and postmen completing probation in September will be retained on civil-service contract terms amid declining mail volumes.
body: Hongkong Post said it will offer two-year civil-service contract appointments rather than permanent terms to roughly 200 postal officers and postmen who complete their probation periods in September.

The department cited continuing declines in mail volume and the need for prudent manpower planning. Staff on the new contracts will retain civil-servant status and benefits, receive annual increments, 5 per cent MPF contributions and a 15 per cent gratuity on completion. Union representatives have expressed opposition to the change.

Hongkong Post said it had explained the arrangement to affected colleagues and would review staffing again once its longer-term operating model is settled. A legislator described the decision as responsible given the department’s self-financing nature.

zh.headline: 香港郵政約200名試用期員工改兩年合約續聘
zh.dek: 因應郵件量持續下降，郵政署表示現時沒有條件向9月完成試用期的郵務員及郵差發出長期聘用條款，改以公務員合約續聘兩年。
body: 香港郵政表示，將向約200名於9月完成試用期的郵務員及郵差，以公務員合約條款續聘兩年，而非發出長期聘用條款。
署方指郵件量持續下跌，必須審慎規劃人力資源。新安排下員工仍維持公務員身份及福利，可繼續按增薪點加薪，獲5%強積金供款及約滿15%酬金。工會代表對改動表示反對。
郵政署已向受影響同事解釋安排，並表示待未來發展路向訂立後會再檢視聘用情況。有立法會議員指此舉顧及公帑運用，屬負責任做法。
